response.query: Which uncertainty metrics (NLL, calibration error, sharpness) and evaluation protocols will we adopt, how will uncertainty heads be trained and validated, and will uncertainty drive hard gating or soft weighting in fusion/control?
response.answer: We will use NLL, calibration error, and sharpness as uncertainty metrics. Uncertainty heads will be trained with cross-entropy loss and validated using held-out datasets. Uncertainty will drive soft weighting in fusion/control.
